edits.text: 火 names a star in Shang oracle-bone inscriptions and later in the Classic of Poetry. One account tentatively identifies the oracle-bone name as 火星; another identifies it as 大火, also called 心宿二 (Antares). The evidence does not explain why the star was called 火.

The star-name use is distinct from the literal sense ‘fire’. One account tentatively reads the oracle-bone occurrence as 火星 without specifying 心宿二 or the planet Mars; another identifies it as 大火/心宿二 (Antares). The evidence does not explain why the star was called 火 or how its name relates to ‘fire’.
